# Vastralaya D2C Fashion Store — Demo Website
# Built by NorthWeb Co.

## What This Is
This is a fictional demonstration website built by NorthWeb Co. to showcase what a D2C fashion e-commerce store could look like. No real products, orders, or payments exist here.

## Structure
- Homepage (index.html) — Hero, categories, featured products, brand story
- Men's T-Shirts (tshirts.html) — 20 product listings
- Kurti Sets (kurtis.html) — 20 product listings  
- Sarees (sarees.html) — 20 product listings
- About (about.html) — Brand story and values
- Contact (contact.html) — Contact form and details
- Cart/Checkout (cart.html) — Demo checkout flow
- Legal pages — Privacy, Terms, Refund, Cookie policies

## Technology
- Pure HTML/CSS/JavaScript — no frameworks
- DPDPA 2023 compliant cookie handling
- Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) — skip links, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation
- Responsive — mobile-first design
- No analytics, no tracking, no third-party embeds

## Design System
- Palette: Warm Ivory (#FAF8F5), Deep Burgundy (#6B1929), Champagne Gold (#B8892A)
- Typography: Cormorant Garamond (headings) + Inter (body)
- Demo by NorthWeb Co. — https://northwebco.shop

## Security Notes (Production checklist)
- Add Content-Security-Policy headers (_headers file)
- Replace placeholder business details
- Connect real payment gateway
- Set up real form endpoint (Formspree/custom API)
- Enable HTTPS
- Set up real cookie analytics only after consent
